name: Driftweave Jogger — Elastic Ankle
description: Relaxed-fit joggers in heathered navy synth-cotton blend, with wide elastic waistband and tapered elastic ankles. Side seams have flat-felled finishing — durable, not decorative. A Circuit staple: wearable for a bar run, a market trip, or just existing on a day off.
functionality: Ankle elastics keep out wind and lake spray; deep side pockets fit a commuter card, snacks, and a hand tool.
what_it_says: You value comfort over performance and practicality over trend.
worn_by: Circuit factory workers on days off
story_hooks: The tail-gusset on the back seam was added by a Circuit tailor who didn't mark it — someone with a geneware tail modified this pair.
A Circuit bar has a running tab system; regulars who show up in Driftweave Joggers get a quiet discount.
